mintAuthority.summary: GBPm has native collateral-bound issuance only on Celo through Mento's Liquity V2 BorrowerOperations path. The Monad StableTokenSpoke is a Wormhole NTT burn/mint representation and its ProxyAdmin is scored under Bridge Risk; the Celo 4-of-6 Mento Safe can replace native mint logic or authorize minter changes.

upgradeability.controlRef: Mento Safe — GBPm token owner and proxy admin

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations — GBPm collateral-bound minter
controls.capDescription: BorrowerOperations mints GBPm only for Liquity V2-style Celo CDP debt after ICR/MCR, TCR/CCR, SCR, and minimum-debt checks; the route is collateral-bound but the token owner can replace mint logic or authorized minters.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 75026011, GBPm StableTokenV3 isMinter(0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A) returned true, while isMinter(0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD) for the deprecated Broker returned false. Verified BorrowerOperations source gates the mint call behind Liquity V2-style ICR/MCR, TCR/CCR, SCR, and minimum-debt checks. The deprecated token storage and Registry Broker entries still resolve to 0x777A..., but they are metadata and not the current StableTokenV3 mint authorization.

controls.label: Mento Safe — GBPm token owner and proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Celo block 75026011, owner() on GBPm and its EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned the 4-of-6 Mento Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458. Current Safe service reads show six owners, threshold 4, no enabled modules, and a zero guard. This Safe can change the native token's authorized minters and replace mint-critical proxy logic, so the ordinary BorrowerOperations path is partially bounded but raiseable.

review.evidence: At Celo block 75026011, the verified StableTokenV3 implementation reported isMinter=true for BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A and false for the deprecated Broker 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD. BorrowerOperations enforces the collateral and debt checks for the normal Celo CDP mint route; current SystemParams reads were MCR 110%, CCR 135%, SCR 110%, and minimum debt 1000e18. The Celo token owner and proxy admin are the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe, which can change minters or replace mint logic, so native issuance is partially-bounded-admin with raiseable economic semantics. Mento's MGP-14 and official NTT configuration identify Monad GBPm as the Wormhole NTT burn/mint representation of Celo GBPm; its ProxyAdmin and NTT controls are therefore excluded from Mint Authority and scored under bridgeRouteRisk. Reconciliation is not-applicable because the reviewed path is on-chain CDP and conserved NTT route accounting rather than an off-chain reserve claim.
